notes.float_format: all floating point values are rounded to 7 significant digits
notes.parameters: init_params() with every spatial and stochastic effect switched off (grain, halation, glare, the camera and the enlarger diffusion filters, the lens blurs, the unsharp mask and the auto exposure), the DIR couplers active but per pixel, the print density curve morph off, the input gamut compression at its upstream default (xy) and the output gamut compression at its upstream default (cam16ucs).
notes.print_cases: the 16 colour negatives printed on the 8 print media (128 cases).
notes.scan_cases: the 20 films scanned directly (io.scan_film = True). The upstream GUI scans the slides (Velvia, Provia, Kodachrome, Ektachrome) directly by default (spektrafilm_gui.state.digest_after_selection) and offers the same for the negatives. The direct scan does not use the print medium at all: the reference paper of the upstream GUI is kept in the parameters, the result does not depend on it.
notes.rgb_in: the camera image is stored once; every case is fed with the same linear ProPhoto RGB image.

test_image.description: row 0: neutral grey ramp log spaced 0.002..2.0; row 1: saturated patches; row 2: skin like patches; row 3: mixed patches (black, white, 50 % grey, 18 % grey, ...); rows 4-5: seeded random block (numpy default_rng(20261109)) log spaced 0.001..4.0
